newsitem.title: HONG KONG: International Bank of Asia mandates HK$ FRCD.
newsitem.headline: International Bank of Asia mandates HK$ FRCD.

text.p: International Bank of Asia has mandated four banks to arrange a HK$500 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue, said arranger Westpac Banking Corp.
The certificates will carry a final maturity of three years.
General syndication is expected to begin on November 14.
The other arrangers are Sakura Finance Asia, Commerz (East Asia) and Dresdner (South East Asia).
Sakura Finance Asia and Commerz (East Asia) are the bookrunners. Westpac Banking Corp will handle the signing.
The borrower completed a HK$75 million one-year privately placed FRCD in August.
In April, it completed a US$70 million FRCD that had a final maturity of five years and put and call options on the third anniversary.
